source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

theLabels: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World

members.reverse: Which famous set is made up of {value}?

rows.label: The Beatles
rows.members: John, Paul, George and Ringo
rows.description: English pop rock band (1960–1970)
rows.hook: led the 1960s British Invasion of the American charts out of Liverpool

rows.label: Spice Girls
rows.members: Scary, Sporty, Baby, Ginger and Posh
rows.description: British girl group
rows.hook: became the best-selling female pop act ever, starting with the hit Wannabe

rows.label: Bee Gees
rows.members: Barry, Robin and Maurice
rows.description: British-Australian pop group; sibling trio (years active: 1958–2003, 2006, 2009–2012)
rows.hook: sang in soaring falsetto on the disco soundtrack hits behind Stayin' Alive

rows.label: Great Lakes
rows.members: Superior, Michigan, Huron, Erie and Ontario
rows.description: group of lakes in North America
rows.hook: form a chain of huge freshwater inland seas shared by two countries

rows.label: Backstreet Boys
rows.members: Nick, AJ, Howie, Brian and Kevin
rows.description: American musical group; boy band
rows.hook: rose to fame as a pop vocal group from Orlando, singing I Want It That Way

rows.label: The Jackson 5
rows.members: Jackie, Tito, Jermaine, Marlon and Michael
rows.description: American pop music family group
rows.hook: was a family act of brothers from Indiana that launched a future King of Pop

rows.label: The Golden Girls
rows.members: Dorothy, Rose, Blanche and Sophia
rows.description: American sitcom
rows.hook: follows four older women who share a home in Miami

rows.label: Mount Rushmore
rows.members: Washington, Jefferson, Theodore Roosevelt and Lincoln
rows.description: mountain in South Dakota featuring a sculpture of four US presidents
rows.hook: has giant granite faces carved into a Black Hills mountainside

rows.label: Grand Slam
rows.members: the Australian Open, the French Open, Wimbledon and the US Open
rows.description: the four most important tennis tournaments
rows.hook: covers the four biggest tennis championships, which a player can sweep in one year

rows.label: The Monkees
rows.members: Davy, Micky, Mike and Peter
rows.description: American pop group
rows.hook: was cast for a TV sitcom and then topped the charts as a real band

rows.label: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
rows.members: the Great Pyramid, the Hanging Gardens, the Statue of Zeus, the Temple of Artemis, the Mausoleum, the Colossus of Rhodes and the Pharos lighthouse
rows.description: list of remarkable constructions of classical antiquity
rows.hook: ranks famed structures of classical antiquity, of which only one still stands

rows.label: The Three Stooges
rows.members: Moe, Larry and Curly
rows.description: American comedy team active from 1922 to 1970
rows.hook: was a slapstick comedy trio famed for eye pokes and hundreds of short films

rows.label: Teletubbies
rows.members: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po
rows.description: British children's television series (1997–2001/2022)
rows.hook: stars colorful creatures with antennae and screens on their bellies who speak gibberish

rows.label: three wise monkeys
rows.members: see no evil, hear no evil and speak no evil
rows.description: pictorial maxim, embodying the proverbial principle “see/hear/speak no evil”, depicted as three monkeys
rows.hook: shows animals covering their eyes, ears and mouth, a Japanese proverb about shunning wrongdoing

rows.label: Rat Pack
rows.members: Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin, Sammy Davis Jr., Peter Lawford and Joey Bishop
rows.description: media term for an informal group of entertainers centered on the Las Vegas casino scene in the 1960s
rows.hook: was a clan of singer-entertainers who made films and starred in Las Vegas casino shows

rows.label: Chinese zodiac
rows.members: rat, ox, tiger, rabbit, dragon, snake, horse, goat, monkey, rooster, dog and pig
rows.description: lunar calendar classification, assigning a symbolic animal and its reputed attributes to each traditional Chinese daily hour or Chinese lunar year for a repeating cycle of twelve forming the Earthly Branch
rows.hook: assigns an animal to each year in a repeating twelve-year cycle

rows.label: Marx Brothers
rows.members: Groucho, Harpo, Chico, Zeppo and Gummo
rows.description: American comedy troupe

rows.label: Infinity Stones
rows.members: space, mind, reality, power, time and soul
rows.description: Items in the Marvel Cinematic Universe
rows.hook: are six powerful gems that Thanos hunts across the Marvel films

rows.label: Labours of Heracles
rows.members: the Nemean lion, the Hydra, the Ceryneian hind, the Erymanthian boar, the Augean stables, the Stymphalian birds, the Cretan bull, the mares of Diomedes, Hippolyta's girdle, Geryon's cattle, the golden apples and Cerberus
rows.description: series of feats carried out by Heracles
rows.hook: is a cycle of twelve tasks performed by the greatest Greek hero

rows.label: The Four Seasons
rows.members: Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter
rows.description: set of four violin concertos by Antonio Vivaldi
rows.hook: is a set of violin concertos that each paint a musical picture of a time of year

rows.label: classical elements
rows.members: earth, water, air and fire
rows.description: group of constituent basic elements of matter (water, earth, fire, air and sometimes aether), used to explain nature patterns since ancient times
rows.hook: were the basic substances ancient thinkers believed made up everything in nature

rows.label: Four Tops
rows.members: Levi, Duke, Obie and Lawrence
rows.description: American vocal quartet

rows.label: Seven Dwarfs
rows.members: Doc, Grumpy, Happy, Sleepy, Bashful, Sneezy and Dopey
rows.description: group of fictional characters in the fairy tale "Snow White"

rows.label: Triple Crown of Thoroughbred Racing
rows.members: the Kentucky Derby, the Preakness Stakes and the Belmont Stakes
rows.description: U.S. racehorse honor: winning Kentucky Derby + Preakness + Belmont Stakes
